component.name: FeedTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "getFeed" end sub
sub getFeed() ' POINT THIS TO THE NEW FEED FILE url = "https://frontdoormedia.org/feeds/frontdoor_shelves_public_v1.json?v=20260210b"
port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetMessagePort(port) xfer.SetUrl(url) xfer.AddHeader("User-Agent", "Roku/FrontDoor") xfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") xfer.InitClientCertificates()
ok = xfer.AsyncGetToString() if ok <> true then m.top.error = "Feed request could not start." return end if
msg = wait(15000, port) if msg = invalid then xfer.AsyncCancel() m.top.error = "Feed timeout (15s)." return end if
if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then code = msg.GetResponseCode() body = msg.GetString()
if body = invalid or body = "" then m.top.error = "Feed empty. HTTP " + code.toStr() return end if
firstChar = Left(body.Trim(), 1) if firstChar <> "{" and firstChar <> "[" then m.top.error = "Feed not JSON. HTTP " + code.toStr() return end if
m.top.response = body return end if
m.top.error = "Feed failed (unexpected response)." end sub
